scope: 11 reviewed public README summaries across Eiren, CORE, AIPCore, ARSHIF, Creative Spark, and Academy repositories; not ecosystem-wide
sourceAuthority: source README files at pinned blob revisions

documents.title: Eiren literary role
documents.summary: Eiren is a warm literary companion for poetry, stories, developmental editing, rhetoric, and protecting the creator's own voice. Creators retain authorship and final approval.

documents.title: EirenCore literary practice
documents.summary: EirenCore documents poetry, literary architecture, narrative continuity, symbolism, character voice, and attentive revision.

documents.title: ARSHIF archives and provenance
documents.summary: ARSHIF preserves source continuity, historical context and provenance, distinguishing historical records from current authority.

documents.title: AIPCore language infrastructure
documents.summary: AIPCore provides shared language processing, dictionary and educational-reference infrastructure. Its adaptive learning changes teaching attention, not authority.

documents.title: Linguistics and language campus
documents.summary: The Linguistics campus hosts formal language pathways, world-language references, a sovereign translator, dictionary tools, and supplemental practice distinct from authoritative mastery records.

documents.title: ARSHIF public library overview
documents.summary: ARSHIF describes a sovereign digital library with age-appropriate youth access, student research resources, educator materials, and preservation aims.

documents.title: Creative Spark writing and idea tools
documents.summary: Creative Spark is a browser-based creative prompt and idea tool with poetic and descriptive modes, a local dictionary resource, and no required account.

documents.title: AIPCore dictionary reference
documents.summary: AIPCore's A–Z English dictionary supports definitions, vocabulary, educational indexing, and writing reference. Canonical entries live in dictionary/letters/.

documents.title: Mentor adaptive learning boundaries
documents.summary: AIPCore's adaptive pattern memory changes teaching attention and strategy, not authority, and excludes credentials, sensitive-trait learning, and authority mutation.

documents.title: Academy mission and access
documents.summary: Khaemenes Academy describes free, comprehensive lifelong learning that encourages curiosity, critical thinking, creativity, and access across ages.

documents.title: Formal language Hall and academic authority
documents.summary: The Linguistics Hall governs five formal language programs and their academic completion semantics; learner-facing language experiences must not create a second completion authority.
